author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven

requires: production robot USD loads from a clean environment
RGB observation and goal-image pipelines work
GNM, ViNT and NoMaD adapters work through one contract
seeds, configuration, checkpoints and assets pinned

additionally_requires: every remaining provisional value resolved or retained with a justified limitation

INVARIANT: FUNCTIONAL is not CALIBRATED. A twin that runs is not a twin that matches the robot

gates.name: ROBOT_ASSET_LOAD
gates.requires: loads from a clean clone with no host-local paths

gates.name: KINEMATIC_STRUCTURE
gates.requires: links, joints, axes, transforms, collision primitives

gates.name: ARM_AND_CAMERA_CONFIGURATION
gates.requires: base_link -> arm_base -> q1..q6 -> mount -> optical frame, arm pose frozen

gates.name: SENSOR_PIPELINE
gates.requires: what the model receives: dimensions, FOV, rate, colour order, normalisation, context frames, goal image, timestamps

gates.name: MULTI_MODEL_EVALUATION
gates.requires: GNM, ViNT and NoMaD on one task

gates.name: PHYSICAL_CALIBRATION
gates.requires: the only gate that can support an as-built claim

model_interface.contract: one NavigationPolicy / ModelAdapter: reset, act, stop_score

canonical_runner.clean_clone_requirement: reproducible from documented dependencies with no reliance on host-local assets

reproducibility_claim_boundary: where simulator or GPU nondeterminism prevents bitwise equality, declare tolerance-based reproducibility rather than asserting exact equality

already_demonstrated: all three model loaders pass (GNM, ViNT, NoMaD)
closed loop run with a released ViNT policy

defective_asset.detail: bound to the USD whose box collider extents F-TWIN-1 measured as the squares of the source values

withdrawn_camera_model.detail: recorded a chassis mast mount. The physical camera is carried by the 6-DOF manipulator, so the transform is configuration-dependent

why_it_does_not_carry_forward.census_not_measurement: twin_acceptance recorded verdict PASS on a physics census that counted rigid bodies, colliders and joints. That is why the squared colliders passed: a collider of the wrong size is still one collider
why_it_does_not_carry_forward.host_local_paths: at least one artefact references an absolute path outside the repository, which DT0 forbids

prior_prototype.retained_because: it is honest engineering history and it shows the shape of the work. It is not admissible and no claim may cite it

SEQUENCING: implementation does not start until the authorised robot-asset tranche reaches its source and asset milestone. The production USD is a prerequisite of DT0, not only of Attempt 003
